description: Runtime idle variation layer (Gate E2). Small procedural events layered on top of the 6 s idle clip so the idle never reads as a mechanical loop. Implemented in 07_WEB_PREVIEW/fox_interactive_e2.html (updateIdleVariation).
gate: active only while idle is the dominant base (idle weight > 0.9), no one-shot is playing, the pointer is not hovering the head or tail and the fox is not being dragged; fades in/out over ~0.25 s

idle_time_scale.note: re-drawn each time the idle clip wraps, so successive loops are not identical in tempo

blink.drives: FOX_Eye_L/R morph Blink (max with the clip value; skipped while the eyes are hidden by an expression)

test_hooks: ?seed=N fixes the random sequence; window.__fox.idleVar exposes the schedule and the event log
